name.value: Horst and Emmy Werner Centre for Active Living

description.value: The Horst and Emmy Werner Centre for Active Living is a White Rock Recreation and Culture wellness hub that brings together health and community services from organizations including Fraser Health, the Alzheimer Society of BC, and the Canadian Cancer Society. It features cardio gyms, mirrored fitness studios offering regular and drop-in classes, and is home to the Peace Arch Curling Club. A café, lounge, and pro-shop round out the amenities, making it a social and active community gathering point.
